shots.focal_element: Floating Meta Quest 3 headset render flanked symmetrically by its two controllers, with the wordmark above
shots.typography: Brand wordmark: rounded geometric sans, medium weight, title case, normal tracking, preceded by the infinity-loop logo mark; fades in from faint to full opacity in the first second. Font guess (low confidence): Meta's Optimistic typeface.
shots.what_happens: Product hero on a soft pastel gradient: the headset and controllers hang centred while the logo and wordmark fade in above; the controllers drift and rotate slightly. At the end the product fades out and three pill-shaped windows of lifestyle footage appear in a row, leading into the next shot.
shots.build_rebuild: Centre a transparent product PNG with two controller PNGs on a pastel radial gradient, fade the logo+wordmark in over 0.5 s with a slight controller float, then crossfade the product away to three rounded-pill video masks that expand into the next clip.

shots.focal_element: Young man on a green sofa in a sunlit living room unpacking the headset, with a single centred word over him
shots.transition_other: pill-shaped mask windows from the end of s001 open up into full-frame footage (mask reveal)
shots.typography: White bold sans, sentence case/lowercase, tight-normal tracking, centred; each word arrives with horizontal motion-blur streaks and replaces the previous one (one word at a time).
shots.what_happens: Lifestyle footage of a man on a sofa picking up the headset while kinetic single words swap centre-frame: 'Introducing' then 'breakthrough', each blurring in from the sides. The sung lyric of the music track starts here (w0-w2), so the audio is song, not voice-over.
shots.build_rebuild: Play a full-bleed lifestyle clip and swap one centred white bold word every ~0.5 s, each entering with a horizontal motion-blur (blur 20px to 0 plus slight x-stretch) on the music beat.

shots.focal_element: Mixed-reality tabletop dungeon rendered on top of a real coffee table, under the caption
shots.typography: White heavy sans, all caps, wide-ish tracking, centred over the table; letters slide in from the sides with strong motion blur before settling.
shots.what_happens: POV of hands lifting the headset to the eyes (the lenses fill frame), then the passthrough view reveals a glowing miniature dungeon city built on the living-room coffee table while 'MIXED REALITY' blurs in and settles. The last sampled frame (6.5 s) already shows a low-angle shot of the user with game characters, which belongs to or bleeds into s004.
shots.build_rebuild: Cut from a POV clip of the headset lenses to the mixed-reality table clip and reveal an all-caps white headline with a horizontal blur-in (letters slide toward centre, blur to 0 over ~0.4 s).

shots.focal_element: User in the headset seen from table height behind animated game characters and a glowing blue die, with the caption floating in perspective
shots.typography: White bold sans, sentence case, normal tracking; the line flies in large and blurred, tilted in 3D perspective, then shrinks and recedes toward the user's head as the shot continues.
shots.what_happens: Wide-angle low shot from inside the tabletop game: characters fight in the foreground while the user watches; the caption swoops in tilted and blurred, then scales down and drifts back into the scene as if placed in 3D space.
shots.build_rebuild: Over a wide-angle MR clip, animate a white bold caption from scale 1.4, rotateY ~-20deg and blur 12px to scale 0.7, rotateY ~10deg and blur 0 over the shot so it appears to recede into the room.

shots.focal_element: A woman in a headset touching a glowing lava portal that has broken through the ceiling
shots.typography: White bold sans, lowercase, normal tracking, centred; holds static, completing the sentence started in s004.
shots.what_happens: Low-angle shot of a user reaching up to a fiery mixed-reality hole in the ceiling with creatures crawling out; the caption 'into your physical space' holds centred, finishing the 'Blend digital objects...' line. A reverse-swoosh SFX candidate (x001) lands mid-shot.
shots.build_rebuild: Hold a centred white bold lowercase caption over a low-angle MR clip for ~1.4 s, continuing the previous shot's sentence so two captions read as one line across a cut.

shots.focal_element: Close-up of a smiling person wearing the headset, framed on the left-centre with a soft window background
shots.typography: No caption overlay; the only text is a small in-UI window title in a plain sans on a floating virtual screen in the second sampled frame.
shots.what_happens: Short reaction close-up of a smiling headset wearer with shallow depth of field; the second sampled frame (11.0 s) shows a different scene, a man on a sofa watching a huge floating 'YouTube VR' window in his room, suggesting an undetected cut inside this shot. The music lyric 'Make it look easy' starts here (w15-w18).
shots.build_rebuild: Cut to a ~0.9 s shallow-depth-of-field reaction close-up on the beat, then to a clip of a virtual app window composited into a real living room.
